summary: The web names an agent the same way everywhere, by its roster name when it has one and otherwise by the last part of its id, so a seat with no declared name no longer appears by its path in the header, sidebar, tabs, thread senders or request cards

replay.detail: Presentation only; no history is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No storage, wire or generated-schema change. The roster, threads and attention rows are read as before.

rules.detail: Grants and delivery policy are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Web only, against the same daemons. A roster name that is the agent's id, or the id without 'agent/' (the label Fractal gives a seat that declares no name), now shows as the id's last part, for example 'atlas'; the full id stays in the hover title of thread senders and launch previews. A request card names who asked by the served raised-by name under the same rule. The connected threads preview now declares its seats as 'Atlas' and 'Manager'.

downtime.detail: Refreshing the web bundle does not interrupt the daemon.

manual.detail: No operator step. A seat shows a chosen name once its declaration sets `name`.

recovery.detail: Rolling the web bundle back restores the previous labels.
